rubric.evidence: Verified SVG 2 ED #TextPathElementSideAttribute (left | right, initial left, animatable yes), WPT SVGAnimatedEnumeration-SVGTextPathElement.html (TEXTPATH_SIDETYPE_LEFT/RIGHT and TypeError on invalid baseVal 0/-1/3), Blink runtime_enabled_features.json5 (SVGTextPathSideAttribute status: stable), WebKit PR #66616 (merged 2026-10-08), BCD svg/elements/textPath.json and api/SVGTextPathElement.json, and ChromeStatus 5422782593761280 on 2026-11-24.

Feature 5422782593761280 appears under 'Enabled by default' in /api/v0/features?milestone=158 with listing name 'SVG textPath side attribute'; slug svg-textpath-side-attribute matches; H1 equals listing name; ChromeStatus row in .doc-table declares full 16-digit ID.

Honest MDN stub (Case A): MDN has dedicated, substantive pages for both Web/SVG/Reference/Attribute/side and Web/API/SVGTextPathElement/side (each with examples, Specifications, and Browser compatibility, verified HTTP 200 on 2026-11-24). Stub exemption applies; no reference-contract.json.

Summarizes both the SVG attribute and reflected DOM property/constants concisely, explains why gendn points to MDN, and surfaces the BCD discrepancy between api/SVGTextPathElement.json (Chrome 158 / Safari preview) and svg/elements/textPath.json (still false).
Worked circular-path and DOM-API examples live on the linked canonical MDN pages; no chrome-platform-showcase demo exists yet (HEAD returned 404 on 2026-11-24).

Accurately distinguishes Firefox 61 (attribute) vs Firefox 152 (DOM property), Chrome 158 desktop/Android/WebView, Edge 158 mirror, Safari Technology Preview (WebKit PR #66616 merged 2026-10-08), and discloses stale false entries in BCD svg/elements/textPath.json.

Every visible source label carries a direct <a href> with target='_blank' rel='noopener'; full 16-digit ChromeStatus ID 5422782593761280; both MDN URLs, SVG 2 spec, WPT, BCD, and WebKit PR verified on 2026-11-24.

Single <main>, single <h1>, sequential h2 headings, semantic quick-reference table with <th scope='row'> inside a keyboard-focusable .table-wrap region (tabindex='0' role='region' aria-labelledby='quick-reference') with 3px :focus-visible outline, and role='note' on the Baseline banner.

Uses shared /public/styles.css semantic tokens without inline overrides of pre/h1/code/.baseline-browsers/blockquote, logical max-inline-size: 100% on .table-wrap, and verified via npm run responsive at desktop (1280x800) and mobile (360x740).

HEAD check on https://chrome-platform-showcase.paulkinlan-ea.deno.net/v158/svg-textpath-side-attribute/ returned 404 on 2026-11-24; no broken iframe or speculative showcase link emitted so manifest demo remains honestly null.
